response.sql:
WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(modindex) as overall_average
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rfistat,
    AVG(modindex) as status_avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
qualifying_statuses AS (
  SELECT sa.rfistat, sa.status_avg_modindex
  FROM status_averages sa, overall_avg oa
  WHERE sa.status_avg_modindex > oa.overall_average
),
mean_of_qualifying AS (
  SELECT AVG(status_avg_modindex) as mean_qualifying_avg
  FROM qualifying_statuses
)
SELECT 
  qs.rfistat,
  qs.status_avg_modindex,
  qs.status_avg_modindex - oa.overall_average as above_average,
  qs.status_avg_modindex - mq.mean_qualifying_avg as diff_from_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying_statuses qs, overall_avg oa, mean_of_qualifying mq
ORDER BY qs.status_avg_modindex DESC;

assumptions.assumption: Each RFI status value (including NULL representing signals with no status) is treated as a group with its collective average modindex; we filter for statuses whose group average exceeds the overall average across all non-NULL modindex values
